Method of Attack: The package contained a hex-encoded payload that, when unpacked, would survey and exfiltrate various items from the system.
It included a survey of the files under the user’s home directory, as well as domain and local network information.
Impacted Systems: Systems with hostnames not matching specific values (e.g., DESKTOP-4E1IS0K, box, lili-pc, aws-7grara913oid5jsexgkq, instance) and users not named 'daasadmin'.
Attack Vector: The payload was executed via a JavaScript function that evaluated the decoded payload.
Indicators of Compromise: Unusual high version numbers (starting in the 90s for major versions).
Network requests to an unknown hostname over HTTPS with exfiltrated data.
